Chapter 1371 - 2: The Void

Chapter 1371: Chapter 2: The Void

When Lin Yuan passed the test, breaking through the time loop.

His life essence transformed to the thirteenth level.

The projection of the Myriad Realms Gate deep in his mind began to change, its aura ethereal.

As if connecting to some supreme time and space.

Until now.

The projection of the Myriad Realms Gate finally stabilized.

Obscure information surged out.

Lin Yuan’s expression was grave, delving his mind into the depths of his consciousness, looking at the still magnificent and grand Myriad Realms Gate.

"It’s still just a projection, not the real thing?"

Lin Yuan observed carefully.

Even though he had now become a thirteenth level time life.

The true body of the Myriad Realms Gate still had not descended.

What appeared in the depths of Lin Yuan’s mind was still a projection.

Only compared to the twelfth level, the projection had become increasingly real.

It became more and more like the majestic and grand Gate of Light he had seen in the strange dream he experienced after sleeping for two thousand years before breaking through to the thirteenth level.

"Even a thirteenth level time life cannot bear the true Myriad Realms Gate?"

Lin Yuan marveled in his heart, almost certain that the Myriad Realms Gate belonged to the fourteenth level.

It’s important to note, Lin Yuan was no ordinary thirteenth level time life. In terms of life essence’s power, he surpassed most in the Second Realm.

In such circumstances, he still couldn’t bear the body of the Myriad Realms Gate.

The terror of the latter was beyond doubt.

"A fourteenth level perfect level weapon or rare treasure?"

Lin Yuan’s expression showed a trace of surprise.

So far, Lin Yuan had never heard of a confirmed perfect time life or fourteenth level treasure.

All information related to the fourteenth level originated from the speculations of thirteenth level time lives.

Especially those Time Lords of the Third Realm, yearning to break their destiny, a way of doing so is to transform into a perfect time life.

But does a perfect time life really exist?

No evidence has ever confirmed it.

This is different from when Lin Yuan first entered the twelfth level, where he heard of information related to thirteenth level time lives.

In the Chaos Void, although thirteenth level time lives rarely appear, they do exist, with many special places housing legacies of thirteenth level.

All are the handiwork of thirteenth level time lives.

But a fourteenth level perfect time life?

In the various dimensional spaces, the only thing related to a perfect time life might be the Source World, but whether the perfect aura contained in the Source World comes from a perfect time life remains unknown.

"At least through the Myriad Realms Gate, I’m certain perfect time lives truly exist."

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

Besides a perfect time life, Lin Yuan really couldn’t think of who could create such a terrifying thing as the Myriad Realms Gate.

...

Although he hadn’t seen the true body of the Myriad Realms Gate.

But stepping into the thirteenth level, improving life’s essence still ’unlocked’ more capabilities of the Myriad Realms Gate.

Lin Yuan absorbed the numerous obscure auras that surged from the Myriad Realms Gate, his expression slightly changing.

Firstly, the current Myriad Realms Gate can not only journey to various Source Worlds but also travel to the past and the future.

The travel to Source Worlds pertains to space, while the past and future involve time.

"The past and future?"

Lin Yuan was secretly shocked.

Time lives can view the timeline, but to truly travel to the past? Only Time Lords can achieve this.

But now? With the help of the Myriad Realms Gate, Lin Yuan can also travel to the past? And according to the obscure information flooding his mind, Lin Yuan can also forcibly alter the past.

Thus affecting the future.

And the backlash from altering the past and affecting the future can also be greatly weakened through the Myriad Realms Gate.

It can even be completely exempted by expending World-Breaking Origin Force.

Of course, forcibly changing the past to affect the future is not a matter of whether there’s backlash or not.

The repercussions from the altered past could very well draw the gaze of a true perfect time life.

If perfect time lives can easily reverse the past and future, then all current timeline experiences would be what perfect time lives desire.

Planned by perfect time lives.

Forcibly altering it would equate to breaking perfect time lives’ arrangements.

This consequence is beyond what any lord can endure.

Perhaps altering a certain past is also part of a perfect time life’s plan for past and future.

In any case, no Time Lord dares to casually change the past.

"Traveling to the past, altering it? With this method, I can kill any time life below the lord level."

Lin Yuan’s face showed a smile.

Even peak Second Realm time lives couldn’t have been born strong, for there must have been a time they were weak.

Lin Yuan could entirely travel to the weak period of this peak Second Realm time life and strike them down.

Thus influencing the future through the past, causing the peak Second Realm time life that died in the past to naturally not exist in the future.

"I can feel that killing a peak Second Realm time life this way costs far less than directly expending World-Breaking Origin Force."

Lin Yuan thought silently to himself.

As for the Third Realm Time Lords?

Time Lords begin to consolidate their timelines, and any attack on a Time Lord’s past self will be immediately detected by the future Time Lord, who will then return to the past to protect their past self.

This is the true strength of a Time Lord.

Essentially devoid of any weakness or shortcoming.

To kill a Time Lord, one can only rely on absolute power.

But who has the raw strength to kill a lord?
